summary: Self-hosted catalogue: registry check of every pinned image tag, and end-to-end deploys of two light apps (Uptime Kuma, FreshRSS) with the application's own rendering code. Docker Desktop could not start on this machine during the run, so the deploys used the Docker Engine inside the Ubuntu WSL distribution; the LAN address probe was refused because WSL NAT networking does not forward the Windows LAN address to WSL. The WPF window itself was not driven.
dockerDesktop: Docker Desktop 4.81.0 (context desktop-linux) stopped at start-up with: starting services: initializing Inference manager: remove .../Docker/run/dockerInference: The file cannot be accessed by the system. The engine pipe never appeared, so no deploy could target desktop-linux.

tagVerification.method: docker buildx imagetools inspect <reference> --format '{{json .Manifest}}' against each registry on 2026-11-09 (no engine needed); the digest is the image index or manifest digest the tag pointed to then. Tags were chosen from each project's latest stable GitHub release or registry tag list.

rejected.quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-10-15T1: no such manifest (latest MinIO release on GitHub)

deployments.engineNote: Docker Desktop (context desktop-linux) did not start on this machine (its backend reported that a stale socket file in its run folder could not be removed), so the Docker Engine inside the WSL distribution named in 'engine' was used. Ports published there reach Windows through WSL localhost forwarding; LAN addresses of the Windows host are not forwarded to WSL in NAT networking mode.

findings: Fixed: the text and log viewer showed terminal colour codes from docker compose logs; streamed and static text now go through the same plain-text filter as the operation panel (TerminalText.Lines, with a UI-state check seen failing first).
Fixed: while the deploy result was on screen the header still counted the projects from before the deploy; the page now refreshes after an operation ends while the wizard is open.
notExercised: Restart, Update, Show compose file, Open in Compose and Open in browser were not invoked in this run.
Heavier apps (GitLab, Immich, Nextcloud, Open WebUI) were not deployed.
windowDrive.cleanup: The backup folder and the pulled image (digest e88415a9..., equal to the registry check) were removed afterwards.
